From the metadata, it looks like the search results were from DuckDuckGo, but the viewport only showed a partial view of the page, and the user had to scroll or expand to see more.

Wait, the viewport only showed 37% of the page, so maybe not all the information was visible. So, maybe the error is that they didn't clearly report the director's name and birthplace. Without that information, the next steps can't proceed to find the birthplace. Also, the search was done on DuckDuckGo, but the viewport was limited. Maybe they should have expanded the view or used another search engine to get more info. But the main issue is not extracting the needed data properly.
